#!/bin/bash
# Auto-generated by Infrahub - do not edit by hand.
# VM: fra1-vm-web01
# Host: fra1-pve-01
# Cluster: FRA1-PROXMOX-CLUSTER (proxmox)
set -euo pipefail

TEMPLATE_VMID="$(qm list | awk -v t="tpl-ubuntu-22.04" '$2 == t {print $1}')"
if [ -z "$TEMPLATE_VMID" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: template tpl-ubuntu-22.04 not found on this node" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Cloud-init user-data rendered by Infrahub (see the vm-userdata artifact).
cat > "/var/lib/vz/snippets/fra1-vm-web01-user-data.yml" <<'CLOUDINIT'
#cloud-config
# VM: fra1-vm-web01 (Linux guest - cloud-init)
hostname: fra1-vm-web01
manage_etc_hosts: true
users:
  - name: admin
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA demo@opsmill
packages:
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
CLOUDINIT

qm clone "$TEMPLATE_VMID" 100 --name "fra1-vm-web01" --full

qm set 100 \
  --cores 4 \
  --memory 8192 \
  --net0 virtio,bridge=vmbr0 \
  --ide2 local-lvm:cloudinit \
  --cicustom "user=local:snippets/fra1-vm-web01-user-data.yml" \
  --ipconfig0 "ip=100.64.0.1/16" \
  --ostype l26 \
  --agent enabled=1

qm disk resize 100 scsi0 80G

qm set 100 --description 'Web server VM - Ubuntu 22.04'

qm set 100 --tags 'web,production'

qm start 100
